output.one_liner: Linear is a streamlined issue tracking and project planning tool for modern teams, featuring fast workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and GitHub integrations

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 supports authorization code and client credentials grant types. API keys are personal static tokens starting with lin_api_.

evidence.snippet: Linear supports OAuth2 authentication, which is recommended if you're building applications to integrate with Linear.
Each user creates a personal API key in Linear under Settings > Security & access > Personal API keys and pastes it when connecting.

access.notes: Pages show self-service OAuth app and API key creation without mentioning approval or sales requirements, but do not explicitly state pricing requirements or free tier availability.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: API key: 2,500 requests/hour (3,000,000 complexity points/hour); OAuth app: 5,000 requests/hour (2,000,000 complexity points/hour); unauthenticated: 600 requests/hour (100,000 points/hour)

evidence.snippet: Learn how to use the GraphQL API to query and mutate your data
When authenticated using an API key you can make up to 2,500 requests per hour.
If you need to know when data updates in Linear, you should use our Webhook functionality.
The Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides a standardized interface that allows any compatible AI model or agent to access your Linear data

buildability.rationale: Self-serve credentials available (OAuth and API key), documented GraphQL API, webhooks, TypeScript SDK, MCP server, and rate limits all documented; Composio toolkit with 48 tools already exists.

overview_evidence.snippet: Linear is a streamlined issue tracking and project planning tool for modern teams, featuring fast workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and GitHub integrations
